dedupe_keys.name: hillmaker a python package for occupancy analysis in discrete entity flow systems

description: hillmaker is a Python package for calculating occupancy statistics from arrival and departure transaction records. Mark Isken at Oakland University and Jacob Norman at UNC Health Rex publish it for capacity analysis in places such as emergency departments and surgical recovery rooms. Statistics vary by time of day and day of week, allowing observed occupancy patterns to inform simulation inputs and comparisons with model outputs. The January 2024 Zenodo release contains a ZIP snapshot of the package under the MIT licence and is free to obtain. The method is not tied to one geographical area or historical period; those come from the supplied transaction data. The landing page does not specify all supported timestamp resolutions or runtime requirements. It is an occupancy-analysis tool, not a complete hospital simulator. No package execution or integration with a related catalogue record was verified.
